records.text: To be the press secretary, it's not a requirement to be the press secretary. We had Anthony Scaramucci as the, as the press secretary. I don't know why you would need to say that you're an attorney outside of your own ego and then try to gaslight us with an answer of, like, China. In China, I did the thing. When somebody asks you explicitly, how long is this going to go on for? And then we get, like always, when we notice the lie, we get yelled at by neocons on the Internet.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
